title: Detect Drift
source_docs: Statistics and Machine Learning Toolbox/Incremental Learning/Drift Detection/Detect_Drift.md
text: Update drift detector states and drift status with new data, 3 inputs, 2 outputs, direct feedthrough, {Mean data type} sets Data type of mean Inherit:; {Select concept drift detector} sets the initial incremental concept drift detector, {Add input port for observation weights} adds third input port for observation, {Sample time (–1 for inherited)} sets the option to specify sample, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the prevention of fixed-point tools from overriding data, {Drift status data type} sets the data type of drift status output Inherit, {Drift status data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of drift status output for range checking, {Drift status data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of drift status output for range checking, {Mean data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of mean for range checking, {Mean data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of mean for range checking, {Variance data type} sets the data type of variance Inherit, {Variance data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of variance for range checking, {Variance data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of variance for range checking, {Weights sum data type} sets the data type of weights sum Inherit, {Weights sum data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of weights sum for range checking and {Weights sum data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of weights sum for range checking. Values come from the instance.
